User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the PDF Spark application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and account identification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp indicating the user's last successful login.

subscriptionId.description: Reference to the current Subscription plan for this user. (Relationship: Subscription 1:N User)

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Defines different subscription plans and their associated features and limits.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subscription entity.

name.description: The name of the subscription plan (e.g., 'Free', 'Premium').

description.description: A detailed description of the subscription plan's benefits and features.

price.description: The monetary price of the subscription plan (e.g., monthly or yearly cost).

currency.description: The currency in which the subscription price is denominated (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

dailyOperationLimit.description: The maximum number of operations a user on this plan can perform daily.

maxFileSizeMB.description: The maximum allowed size for a single file upload in megabytes (MB).

storageLimitGB.description: The total cloud storage limit for user files on this plan in gigabytes (GB).

features.description: A list of features included in this subscription plan.

File.title: File
File.description: Represents a document (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Image) uploaded by a user or generated by an operation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the File entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns or uploaded this file. (Relationship: User 1:N File)

originalFileName.description: The original name of the file as provided by the user during upload.

storagePath.description: The internal path or URL where the file is stored in cloud storage.

fileType.description: The MIME type of the file (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'text/plain').

fileSize.description: The size of the file in bytes.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the file was uploaded.

isProcessed.description: Indicates whether this file is the result of a processing operation.

associatedOperationId.description: Reference to the Operation that generated this file, if it is an output file. (Relationship: Operation 1:N File)

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.description: Represents a single action performed by a user using one of the PDF Spark tools (e.g., PDF Merge, AI Summarize).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Operation entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated this operation. (Relationship: User 1:N Operation)

status.description: The current status of the operation (e.g., 'PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was initiated.

completedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was completed or failed.

inputFilesIds.description: An array of IDs referencing the File entities used as input for this operation. (Relationship: File N:N Operation)

outputFilesIds.description: An array of IDs referencing the File entities generated as output by this operation. (Relationship: File N:N Operation)

aiPrompt.description: The specific prompt text sent to the AI service for AI-based operations.

aiResult.description: A summary or snippet of the AI response, or a reference to a File ID if the AI output is a document.

UsageLog.title: UsageLog
UsageLog.description: Records individual tool usages or API requests made by users for analytics, rate limiting, and potential billing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UsageLog entry.

userId.description: Reference to the User who made the request. (Relationship: User 1:N UsageLog)

operationId.description: Reference to the Operation entity associated with this usage log entry, if applicable. (Relationship: Operation 1:N UsageLog)

toolUsed.description: The specific tool or API endpoint accessed (e.g., 'PDF_MERGE_TOOL', 'AI_SUMMARIZE_API').

requestTimestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the request was made.

costUnits.description: A numeric value representing the 'cost' or consumption units of the request for rate limiting or billing purposes.

ipAddress.description: The IP address from which the user's request originated, for security and rate limiting.

SystemConfig.title: SystemConfig
SystemConfig.description: Global system configuration settings manageable by the administrator.

definition.description: Global collection of usage logs for administrative management.
Contains definitions of different subscription plans.
Stores metadata for files uploaded or generated by a user.
Records details of operations performed by a user.
Logs individual tool usages and API requests for rate limiting and auditing purposes.
